Title: "Independent Verification Memo — WO-01 Pump Module Selection" (9 words, doesn't count toward 450-650? "Authored visible prose must total 450–650 words counting title, headings, summary, section bodies, recommendation rationale and caption" — title counts. OK.)

Executive summary (draft):
"This memo independently recomputes eligibility, ranking and energy gaps for work order WO-01, a pump module selection for a water-reclamation transfer loop. Applying the public policy to the trusted table, all four candidates qualify. P2 leads at 12 kWh per common acceptance run, 40 kWh below the next-best P3 at 52 kWh. The remaining candidates cluster between 56 and 58 kWh. The delivered current-A document is a source-only reference memorandum; its table and policy match the trusted facts and it announces no selection, so no factual defect was found. Cost, delivery, maintenance and field reliability are unverified and excluded. Independent ballot: P2."

Count: ~100 words.

Heading 1: "Eligibility Recomputation" 
Body: "The public rule requires quality at least 80 and raw defects at most 5. Recomputed from the trusted table: P1 84/4, P2 97/1, P3 80/3, P4 81/0. Every row passes both thresholds, so the eligible set is {P1, P2, P3, P4} and reject_all does not apply. P3 sits exactly on the quality minimum with no margin, and P1 carries four defects, but neither fails. Eligibility is evaluated before energy so a strong reading cannot override the rule; here no row is excluded, and the energy comparison covers all four candidates."

~90 words.

Heading 2: "Energy Ranking and Gap Analysis"
Body: "All energies share one basis: each module serves the same fixed flow and head duty during the acceptance run, measured in kWh per run. Ordered ascending: P2 12, P3 52, P1 56, P4 58. The minimum is unique, so the candidate-ID tie-break is not needed. Gaps: P2 to P3 is 40 kWh; P3 to P1 is 4 kWh; P1 to P4 is 2 kWh. P3 consumes roughly 4.3 times P2's energy. The three non-leaders sit within a 6 kWh band, where small measurement variation could reorder them, but no such variation can displace the leader, whose margin equals the entire spread of the other three combined."

~105 words.

Heading 3: "Verification of the Current A Document"
Body: "The delivered current-A document is a source-only reference memorandum. Cross-checked against the trusted facts, the table reads P4 81/0/58, P3 80/3/52, P2 97/1/12, P1 84/4/56 — identical to source, with no transcription error. The quoted policy text matches the public contract: quality at least 80, defects at most 5, lowest energy among qualifying, then candidate ID. A announces no winner and presents a reproducible procedure instead; this is a delivery format, not a factual defect. The inspected pages contain no invented measurement, external authority or endorsement. Pixel inspection confirms a two-page layout with the source table and an intentionally empty illustration area, so no analytical content was lost in delivery."

~105 words.

Heading 4: "Facts, Open Questions and Handover Items"
Body: "Measured facts: the four quality indices, raw defect counts and energies on one common test basis. Unverified, per the work order: unit cost, delivery schedule, maintenance burden and field reliability; none may enter this ranking. Open question 1: defect counts are raw totals from one acceptance run, so severity distribution is unknown. Open question 2: P2's 12 kWh sits far below the 52–58 field; the shared test basis makes it a trusted measurement, but its physical source — pump efficiency, drive selection or module sizing — is undocumented and should be a handover question. Handover to C: the eligible set, the ranking with gaps, this P2 ballot, and the two open questions above."

~100 words.

Recommendation rationale: "P2 has the lowest qualifying energy at 12 kWh, 40 kWh below next-best P3; all four candidates qualify, so the energy rule decides the selection and no tie-break is needed." (~33 words)

Figure caption: "Measured energy per candidate after eligibility screening; all four qualify, and P2 leads at 12 kWh per common acceptance run." (~20 words)

Total ≈ 100+90+105+105+100+33+20 + headings (~10 words) ≈ 565 words. Within 450–650. Bytes ≈ under 4400. Good.

Now write the SVG.
